Fluffy Pancakes

Directions

  1. Sift flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt together in a large bowl. Make a well in the center and pour in milk, egg, and melted butter; mix until smooth.

  2. Heat a lightly oiled griddle or pan over medium-high heat. Pour or scoop the batter onto the griddle, using approximately 1/4 cup for each pancake; cook until bubbles form and the edges are dry, about 2 to 3 minutes. Flip and cook until browned on the other side.
